name: Atomic Filament
summary: Founder-operated US filament extruder in Kendallville, Indiana, started in 2014. Every spool is manufactured in-house and the brand positions on tight diameter control (claimed +/-0.02 mm) plus specialty UV-reactive and shade-shifting colors.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Plant-based (corn/sugarcane) PLA marketed alongside the petroleum-based lines; UV-reactive and shade-shifting/color-change specialty colors.

product_lines.name: PETG and PCTG
product_lines.notes: PCTG is sold as a distinct copolyester grade from PETG.

product_lines.name: Carbon fiber composites
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fiber filled grades; exact base-polymer lineup not itemised in sources, so the filament ids here are inferred from the base catalog.

additional_notes: Corporate entity name beyond the trading name "Atomic Filament" was not confirmed; address of record is 6928 North 400 East, Kendallville, Indiana. Founded 2014 by a founder identified publicly only as "Mike"; privately owned with a hands-on founder-operator model. Sells 3.5 kg jumbo rolls and sample packs. No nylon, PC, TPU, PVA or HIPS lines confirmed. Filament Cheat Sheet rates the brand Tier A. A rumored link to Proto-pasta or 3D Printlife was searched for and returned no corroborating evidence — treat any such claim as unfounded; oem_relationships is therefore empty.

provenance.conflicts: An unsourced community claim linking Atomic Filament to Proto-pasta / 3D Printlife could not be corroborated and is recorded here as rejected rather than encoded as a relationship. Carbon-fiber base polymers are inferred, not documented.
